claims.sentence: You must submit your application and all attached documents no later than one month before the University's established start date of the academic year
Submit a personal application addressed to the head of the University to the structural unit responsible for admissions
When you submit the application, you must present an identity document
You must also complete a consent form for the processing of personal data in accordance with Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 27.07.2006
Based on this consent, the University may enter your information into federal, regional, and municipal information systems
Attach the following to your application
A copy of your education document or education and qualification document

A copy of a certificate (or certificates) of your study period confirming successful completion of previous intermediate certifications at other educational organizations, if you are studying in the form of self-education
A 3x4 cm photograph
Any other documents that serve your interests as a person wishing to be enrolled as an extern
The University's examination commission reviews your submitted documents to decide whether you can be enrolled as an extern
The commission's decision is formalized in a protocol
Based on the examination commission's protocol, the University concludes a contract for paid educational services with you as an extern
The University then issues an order enrolling you as an extern to pass intermediate and final state certification
The evidence does not specify the exact address or contact details of the structural unit responsible for admissions
It does not state whether the application can be submitted online or only in person
The evidence does not specify the timeline for the examination commission to review the documents or issue the protocol
It does not mention the cost, payment schedule, or terms of the paid educational services contract
The evidence does not clarify what happens if the commission denies the application
It does not specify how or when the enrollment order is communicated to the student
